'''The Pit''' was an area of stray [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] scattered throughout the arm of a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] and located at the end of the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]]. Despite being easier to navigate than the Kessel Run, [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who had made it by [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] would often be so relieved at having passed through the most dangerous part of the run that they would lose focus entering the Pit and collide with an asteroid, destroying their [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]].
